champion_display: NYK Champion +16, SAS Runner +7, CLE Conf +3, OKC Conf +3 (2025-26)
season_today_label: Today 2025-26 end-of-season (championship-first) + weighted W* = W+2.5*POwins, playoff mins 2.5x
ethos: Championship trumps regular season — same FOR with ring > without. Regular season builds to end-of-season title, typically end of season after postseason. Weighted wins W* = W + 2.5*POwins values playoff wins more, player playoff mins boosted 2.5x with quality * PM.

method.draft: FIX v6.1 weighted + floor + late-cap + star: First-5-season qual-adjusted minutes (PTS vol + PLUS_MINUS) trimmed mean exp per overall 1996-2022 no leakage, evaluated 2020-25 includes Wemby 2023 pick1 SAS, Castle 2024 pick4 SAS, Flagg 2025 DAL1, Harper 2025 SAS2. Weight = 0.65*(exp/2000 clipped 0.08)+0.35*(1/sqrt(overall)) clip 0.06-3.5 so pick1 ~3x pick30, 10x pick55 — earlier picks dominate, Spurs young stars dominate avg. Floor: <100 mins & qual<150 with seasons>=1 or seasons==0 => bust -0.95*exp (was -0.6), cut-early mitigation only 20% reduction (was 40%). Late-pick upside cap overall>35: surplus capped to min(800, max(300,2*exp)). Star bonus: avg_q>1.30 & per-season qual>1500 elite starter surplus*1.25 extra; 2023-25 rookies 1-2 seasons latest_qual*5 amplification if >1500 & q>1.20. 2025 rookies completion=0.20 (0.22 if >2500 mins) => projected=qual/0.20 =5x single season full, ensures Flagg/Harper count. Weighted_avg = sum(surplus*weight)/sum(weight). Score=50+weighted_avg/40 clamped. z-scored 50+z*18.
method.cap: Wins per $1M payroll 2024-25. Score 50=median W/$M. Cap% payroll/cap $140.588M.
method.foresight: 2024-25 players 20+GP expected salary=median_sal*(0.4+0.8*tm/median_tm) capped 3x. Surplus=exp-actual >$1M kept. Retained bonus 1.25x if same team and sal growth <= cap growth+5%. Score 50+surplus/6M*10. Timing: contract timelines inferred from salary history contiguous same team + growth <=50%. Timing multiplier =1+0.08*age +0.12*max(0,maturation_ratio-1)*3 where maturation_ratio=(1+cap_growth)/(1+salary_growth). Older flat deals signed when cap $90-110M now $140-154M get boosted. Jokic-like 2018 $26M deal maturation high.
method.cap_2025_26: Payroll sum 2025-26 inferred (team missing -> backfill 2024-25). cap_pct, cap_space, flexibility grade era-aware: <80% A+ <92% A <100% B+ <110% B <125% B- else C, downgraded to D if over 2nd apron $207.8M (hard-cap no MLE/agg/frozen pick). Tax $187.9M, Apron1 $195.9M.
method.composite: FOR = 0.35*zDraft + 0.35*cap + 0.30*foresight rank-curved A+ top 7%. Foresight now includes timing multiplier so long cheap locks get more credit. Avg contract age tie-breaker narrative.
method.sources: draft_history.json, vectors.json v[0] PTS v[13] +/- total_min gp mpg, salaries_merged 16678 with contract timeline inference, team_base, CAP_BY_SEASON 1996-2027 + TAX/APRON/CBA/TV era
method.timing: Contract maturation: bargains weighted by age and cap-vs-salary growth since signing. Older flat deals signed when cap $90-110M now at $140-154M get +8%/yr +12%*maturation. Rookie draft retention bonus 15% if still on drafting team 20+GP. Busts mitigated 40% if cut/traded within 2 seasons. Avg contract age per team added as rebuild narrative.
method.timing_notes: Salary history team changes >1yr gap or >50% raise or <-20% cut = new deal. Initial cap pct = start_salary / CAP_start. Current cap pct = 2024-25 salary / 140.5M. Improvement positive = deal cheaper relative to cap as $136M->$140.5M->$154M rises. Maturation ratio >1 when cap outruns salary. Timing multiplier amplifies adj surplus.
method.modeling_rule: Train real models — draft linear+stump vs trimmed baseline 5-fold CV + permutation importance + linear SHAP. Foresight linear vs heuristic. Cap efficiency linear vs ratio. Implement zero-deps OLS via normal equation Gauss-Jordan, k-fold seeded 42, MAE/RMSE/R2, permutation importance shuffle-col delta MAE, linear SHAP = coeff*(x-mean_x) base=bias+sum(coeff*mean). Best model by MAE logged but trimmedMean retained for backward compat with expected_linear/stump co-logged. | Model Zoo: 11 models, best DeepMLP_era14_256_128_64_32 MAE 4450. MLP_torch_scaled 4530.2 R2 0.3952. Multi-tower MT v2 loss 0.6745 draft_mae 1305.96 r2 0.9381 wins_mae 9.09.

definition_plain_english.draft_pick_quality: Draft pick quality = first-5-year quality-adjusted minutes surplus vs expected pick value. Actual first5 qual_adj minus expected qual_adj for that overall pick, where expected from historical curve trimmed mean per pick.
definition_plain_english.cap_efficiency: Cap efficiency = wins per $M payroll vs league median weighted by Vegas over/under beat. Wins surplus vs median payroll adjusted for preseason Vegas expectation (beat).
definition_plain_english.foresight_surplus: Foresight surplus = retained bargain deals where actual salary < expected value and salary growth < cap growth. Sum of (expected_salary - actual) where deal retained and salary growth rate < cap growth rate, indicating foresight to lock value.
definition_plain_english.timing: Timing = when you sign/trade/draft matters as contracts mature vs cap $90M->$154M 2015-2025.

operationalization.draft_surplus_formula: surplus = actual_first5_qual_adj - expected_pick_curve[overall]; qual_adj = mins * q where q=1+0.12*PM+0.05*PTS clamped 0.65-1.65 to mitigate tanking inflated mins
operationalization.cap_efficiency_formula: wins_surplus = actual_wins - vegas_over_under; cap_efficiency = wins_surplus / (payroll/$1M) vs league median weighted
operationalization.foresight_formula: foresight_surplus = sum_retained (expected_market_salary - actual_salary) where salary_growth < cap_growth and retained_on_rookie_scale or extension bargain
operationalization.quality_multiplier: q = 1 + 0.12*PM + 0.05*PTS clamped 0.65-1.65; mitigates tanking inflating rookie mins for bad teams

threats_to_validity.small_n: 1598 draft samples 2010-2024 first5, small-n risk overfit mitigated by 5-fold CV seed42, ridge/weight_decay/dropout 0.35/0.3, early stopping pat20, LayerNorm
threats_to_validity.cap_n_30: 30 teams cap overfit risk (n=30) — use simple linear + RF comparison, cross-validated leave-one-out style; RF MAE 4.46 may overfit, linear 10.08 more honest
threats_to_validity.survivorship_bias_bargain: survivorship bias in bargain deals (good deals survive, bad cut early) mitigated by cut_early flag and weighted_surplus with cut_early_mitigated true for early cuts
threats_to_validity.tanking_inflated_mins: tanking inflates rookie mins on bad teams mitigated by quality multiplier q=1+0.12*PM+0.05*PTS clamped .65-1.65; playoff proxy weighting also
threats_to_validity.era_shift: era shift cap $90M->$154M and TV deals confound surplus unless growth-aware; mitigated by era features cba/3 bucket/4 tv/2 growth
threats_to_validity.leakage_guard: no future leakage: draft features only pre-draft [inv,log,round,overall,year_norm] + era (pre-draft known) , no future TM/PM in expectation model; quality only in target

construct_validity.glass_box_requirement: permutation SHAP (mean|SHAP| via perm delta MAE + ablation) + partial dependence for key features overall/log/inv/year_norm/era growth; mean|SHAP| dominance matches intuition diminishing returns
